description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'GenericMapSet' which extends 'GenericMapCollection' and implements the 'Set' interface. It provides custom implementations for 'equals' and 'hashCode' methods to handle set comparison semantics, likely as part of a collection utilities package in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericMapSet
classes.description: An abstract generic class implementing a Set based on a Map as the source collection, with custom equality and hash code logic.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare the set with another Set for equality based on size and contained items.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() to compute a hash code based on the hash codes of the contained items.
